title: Two-filtration bridge map in full generality: bar-class determines iterated-integral depth (self-conj $\to$ 2, chiral pair $\to$ 3) for all partitions
html:
Proposition. Two-filtration bridge map in full generality: bar-class determines iterated-integral depth (self-conj \to 2, chiral pair \to 3) for all partitions

prop:two-filtration-bridge-small-cases verified the bridge map d_{\mathrm{II}} at all partitions of n \leq 4. This proposition extends the verification to all partitions of any n via a structural bar-eigenspace argument.

Statement

For every partition \lambda (of any n \geq 1), the iterated- integral depth predicted by the two-filtration bridge conjecture (conj:two-filtration-bridge) depends only on the bar-class of \lambda:

  \boxed{\;
    d_{\mathrm{II}}(\lambda)
    \;=\;
    \begin{cases}
      2 & \text{if } \lambda \text{ is self-conjugate } (\lambda = \lambda'), \\
      3 & \text{if } \{\lambda, \lambda'\} \text{ is a chiral pair } (\lambda \neq \lambda').
    \end{cases}
  \;}

Corollaries

Generalisation: the small-cases bridge verification at n \leq 4 extends to all n via the bar-eigenspace argument.

Corollary for the depth correspondence:

  • For each self-conjugate cell, its depth-2 row is theorem-level (combining Bloch–Suslin + per-knot VC where available).
  • For each chiral pair, its depth-3 row is conditional on the CS computation per knot.

Combined with prop:cyclotomic-cl3-orbit-sum-general + prop:cyclotomic-trilog-imaginary-closed-form: the depth-3 content over \mathbb{Q}(\zeta_N) for every prime N is controlled by \lfloor (N - 1)/2 \rfloor - 1 genuinely-new real numbers, all pairing with chiral-pair cells in the appropriate H_n(q).
